title: Fabric Supersat environment properties
description: src/Environments/<Name>/<Name>.yaml: properties of the Fabric environment in this folder. The environment's name is its folder name.

description.description: The environment's description in Fabric. Upload sets it; "" clears it. Without it, upload leaves the description in Fabric as it is.

folder.description: The workspace folder the environment is in, as a path of folder names such as "Shared", matched by name in each workspace. Upload creates any missing folders and moves the environment there; "" is the workspace root. Without it, upload leaves the environment where it is in Fabric (new environments go in the root). Folder names can't contain ~ " # . & * : < > ? { | } or start or end with a space; at most 10 levels.
